factor_name: Innovative efficiency based on adjusted citations scaled by R&D expenses (EMI2)
economic_intuition: Citations capture the technological or economic significance of patents; adjusted citations per dollar of R&D measure efficient innovation output that predicts returns.
detailed_definition: Adjusted citations occurring in year y to firm i's patents granted over the previous five years, scaled by R&D expenses in years y-3 through y-7.

source_details: market equity at the end of June
U.S. patents granted by the USPTO

required_fields.concept: Domestic common shares included by the paper.
required_fields.source_detail: All domestic common shares trading on NYSE, AMEX, and NASDAQ with accounting and returns data available are included.

required_fields.concept: NYSE, AMEX, or NASDAQ trading venue named by the paper.
required_fields.source_detail: The paper states stocks trade on NYSE, AMEX, and NASDAQ.

required_fields.concept: Four-digit SIC code used to exclude financial firms with codes between 6000 and 6999.
required_fields.source_detail: Financial firms have four-digit SIC codes between 6000 and 6999 and are excluded.

required_fields.concept: Security/listing attributes used to exclude closed-end funds, trusts, ADRs, REITs, and units of beneficial interest.
required_fields.source_detail: The paper excludes closed-end funds, trusts, ADRs, REITs, and units of beneficial interest.

required_fields.concept: Book value of equity used to exclude firms with negative book value.
required_fields.source_detail: The paper excludes firms with negative book value of equity.

required_fields.source_detail: The paper requires firms to be listed on Compustat for two years before sample inclusion.

required_fields.source_detail: Stock returns data are from CRSP.

required_fields.concept: One-month Treasury bill rate for excess-return context and factors.

required_fields.concept: Citations received in the IE year by firm patents granted in the previous five years.
required_fields.source_detail: The database contains the number of citations received by each patent.

required_fields.concept: Average citations used to adjust citation counts for patent subcategory, grant year, and citing year.
required_fields.source_detail: The paper scales citations by average citations for patents of the same subcategory and grant year in the citing year.

required_fields.concept: R&D expenses in lagged fiscal years y-3 through y-7 used as the Citations/RD denominator.
required_fields.source_detail: The denominator is the sum of R&D expenses in years t-3 to t-7.

formula.expression: sum_{j=1..5} sum_{k=1..N_y_minus_j} adjusted_citation_count_{k,y,y-j} / (rd_y_minus_3 + rd_y_minus_4 + rd_y_minus_5 + rd_y_minus_6 + rd_y_minus_7)
formula.paper_expression: Citations/RD = [sum adjusted citations in year t to patents granted in t−1..t−5] / (R&D_i,t−3 + R&D_i,t−4 + R&D_i,t−5 + R&D_i,t−6 + R&D_i,t−7)

evidence.quote: patents granted over the previous five years
evidence.interpretation: The paper provides the citation adjustment, five-year patent window, and R&D denominator lag structure.

evidence.quote: IE measures in year t – 1 are fully observable
evidence.interpretation: The EMI factor forms portfolios at the end of June t using IE from year t-1; this is a June formation delay rather than an explicit accounting lag for the EMI factor.
The paper explicitly sets missing R&D to zero in denominator calculations, but does not otherwise state a global missing-data imputation rule.

portfolio.universe: Domestic common shares on NYSE, AMEX, and NASDAQ in the intersection of Compustat, CRSP, and the NBER patent database, excluding financial firms and specified non-common/listing types.

evidence.interpretation: The paper sorts firms independently into two size groups and three IE groups, with size based on the NYSE median and IE based on tercile breakpoints.
